positions.name: Applied Materials, Inc.
positions.catalyst: Re-upped. Friday's FQ3 print (Aug 13) was a beat AND a large raise — FQ4 revenue guide $10.25B +/- $0.5B vs $9.54B consensus (~7% above), adj. EPS $3.82-4.22 vs $3.69 est — yet the stock gapped down ~6% to $497. It reversed hard intraday Friday (low $497.10, high $523.00, close $507.18) and is extending to ~$516 pre-market. Fresh sector fuel Monday: the memory shortage trade is re-accelerating (MU +3.5%, SNDK +5.5%, WDC +3.8%, STX +2.6% pre-market) on Samsung/SK hynix warnings that AI-driven memory shortages run through 2027-28, which is a direct read-through to wafer-fab-equipment capex — Lam already lifted its 2026 WFE view to the 'low $150B range' from $140B.
positions.driver: The gap-down on a beat has been rejected: Friday's low held and price has now reclaimed the close and is 3.8% off that low, turning the failed breakdown into a definable-risk long. Entry $516 sits ~6% below the $548 pre-print price and ~30% below the $739.67 52-week high (Jun 30), against a ~$640 consensus target (~24% above entry). AMAT is also the cheapest of the WFE trio (43.7x trailing vs LRCX 57.7x, KLAC 55.7x) and the least-extended pre-market — no chasing. Stop $482.85 sits below Friday's entire range, so invalidation is unambiguous.
positions.risks: Second-day continuation trades fail when the gap-down de-rating resumes — the tape has been marking down semi-cap multiples since the Jun 30 peak (AMAT -30%, KLAC -33%, LRCX -23% off highs) and China domestic-toolmaker share loss remains the structural overhang. Entry is $14 worse than Friday's, so less margin of safety. Ex-dividend Aug 20 ($0.53). Beta 1.62; a heavy retail-earnings week (HD Tue, TGT/TJX Wed, WMT Thu) could swing broad risk appetite. Momentum-derivative bet with no forced buyer.
